workflow: Multiple threads access the same shared mutable sequence concurrently.
One thread rearranges the sequence elements in place while another thread reads the same storage without synchronization.
The overlapping reads and writes form a data race with undefined behavior.
Race detection or ordinary execution exposes the invalid concurrent access, causing the operation or process to fail.
summary: Concurrent unsynchronized mutation and reading of shared sequence storage
decision_reason: The underlying failure workflow is materially the same as workflow-0081: unsynchronized concurrent reads and writes to shared mutable storage. The sequence representation and sorting-specific symptoms differ, but the causal mechanism is identical.
